decisive_semantics.reference_output_parameters: removeJumpTable(JumpTable *jt) reads jt->getIndirectOp() BEFORE delete jt (cc:73->74 ordering), then op->getParent()->clearFlag(f_switch_out) mutates the shared block flags through the pointer chain — a cross-object reference write, not a copy. Rugra: get_indirect_op() read before the retain-drop; parent block Weak-upgrade + write lock clear_flags(SWITCH_OUT); upgrade failure = block already dead, no flag to clear (ownership-model equivalent of Ghidra's guaranteed-alive parent for a live BRANCHIND).
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: jumpvec begin()..end() single pass retaining every pointer != jt; jumpvec = remain assignment closes AFTER the flag clear (cc:77). Rugra retain single pass over the same vector; read-op order preserved (op read first, table dropped, flag cleared).

decisive_semantics.sorting_comparison_keys: sole comparison is pointer identity (*iter) != jt; Rugra uses Arc::as_ptr identity — exact correspondence, no ordering key.
